entries.question: May the plugin infer permanent model capability from provider/model identity?
entries.decision: No unscoped inference. Provider plugin owns protocol adaptation; future discovery needs explicit source/lifetime/scope authority.

entries.question: May dynamic provider feedback be stored as permanent capability truth?
entries.decision: No. Current dynamic feedback is evidence with a scope and lifetime; missing feedback is not false and stale feedback must not defeat current feedback.

entries.question: How can Volcengine model-card UI be shown without polluting foreign providers?
entries.decision: Use owned-Source conditional temporary UI keys and translate/remove them at the save boundary; do not install an unconditional canonical shared-schema field.

entries.question: What does migration preserve?
entries.decision: Preserve user configuration intent, not a model capability fact. Explicit false remains explicit information and outranks historical modalities clues.

entries.question: Does successful or failed interaction grant authority to make a global capability verdict?
entries.decision: No. Interaction is lower-level evidence; judgment requires sufficient conditions, scope, and decision authority.

entries.question: Must every release repeat the full QQ audio/video E2E?
entries.decision: No. Historical product-path evidence remains evidence until a relevant dependency edge changes; full QQ-equivalent revalidation is impact-triggered.

active_evidence.goal: 0.1.17 release evidence across plugin contracts, AstrBot integration, downstream Ark attribution, historical QQ product regressions, and the minimal runtime distribution boundary
active_evidence.reason: Each layer may judge only the interface it actually exercises; raw provider fixtures and brittle UI automation must not silently redefine QQ product compatibility.

warning: This index is navigation metadata for humans and AI agents. It has no runtime authority.
